description: Scrape live scores, fixtures, standings, team/player profiles, match details and rankings from SofaScore across 25 sports. No login or API key.

date.description: Start date for fixtures (mode=scheduled), format YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today UTC.
date.title: Date

daysAhead.description: Number of extra days after Date to include (mode=scheduled).
daysAhead.title: Days Ahead

eventIds.description: SofaScore match IDs or match page URLs (mode=event).
eventIds.title: Match IDs or URLs

includeAdvanced.description: Add shotmap, momentum, average positions, best players, win probability, managers, streaks and pre-game form.
includeAdvanced.title: Include Advanced Match Data

includeComments.description: Add the text commentary feed to match records. This is a large payload.
includeComments.title: Include Commentary

includeEvents.description: Add recent and upcoming events to team records (mode=team).
includeEvents.title: Include Team Events

includeH2h.description: Add head-to-head win/draw tallies to match records.
includeH2h.title: Include Head-to-Head

includeIncidents.description: Add goals, cards and substitutions to match records.
includeIncidents.title: Include Incidents

includeLineups.description: Add lineups, formations and player ratings to match records.
includeLineups.title: Include Lineups

includeOdds.description: Add pre-match odds markets to match records.
includeOdds.title: Include Odds

includePlayerStats.description: Add per-competition season statistics to player records (mode=player).
includePlayerStats.title: Include Player Statistics

includeSquad.description: Add the full squad to team records (mode=team).
includeSquad.title: Include Squad

includeStandings.description: Add the league table to tournament records (mode=tournament).
includeStandings.title: Include Standings

includeStatistics.description: Add team and player statistics to match records.
includeStatistics.title: Include Statistics

includeVotes.description: Add crowd prediction polls to match records.
includeVotes.title: Include Votes

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return. 0 means no user limit (hard cap 10,000).
maxItems.title: Max Items

enumTitles: Match details by ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

playerIds.description: SofaScore player IDs or player page URLs (mode=player).
playerIds.title: Player IDs or URLs

searchQueries.description: Team, player, tournament or match names to resolve (mode=search).
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

searchType.description: Restrict search results to one entity type (mode=search).
searchType.title: Search Result Type

seasonId.description: Optional season ID for standings or tournament mode. If omitted, the latest season with a table is used.
seasonId.title: Season ID

sports.description: Sports for live and scheduled modes. Supported: football, basketball, tennis, american-football, aussie-rules, ice-hockey, handball, rugby, futsal, minifootball, floorball, volleyball, badminton, table-tennis, padel, snooker, baseball, cricket, esports, darts, mma, cycling, motorsport, waterpolo, bandy.
sports.title: Sports

tableType.description: Standings table to fetch (modes standings, tournament).
tableType.title: Table Type

teamIds.description: SofaScore team IDs or team page URLs (mode=team).
teamIds.title: Team IDs or URLs

tournamentIds.description: SofaScore unique-tournament IDs or tournament page URLs (modes tournament, standings).
tournamentIds.title: Tournament IDs or URLs

title: SofaScore Scraper Input
